title: pyg-bench published docs numbers
summary: The boundary between this repository and the pygraphistry docs. pyg-bench MEASURES and
PUBLISHES; pygraphistry pretty-prints. Everything a consumer is allowed to assume about
published/docs-numbers.json is written down here, checked on the producer side before the
artifact is written, and re-verified independently on the consumer side before it renders.
Two independent implementations of these rules is the point: a shared library would fail
the same way on both sides of the boundary.

invariants.rule: every cell.run must be a key of runs
invariants.why: a number whose provenance record is absent is an unprovenanced number
a diagnostic-only figure must never reach a board
partial / adapter_workaround / result_mismatch cells are not results

invariants.rule: status != 'ok' or comparison_allowed is false implies disclosures is non-empty
invariants.why: a bare ratio without its asterisk launders the caveat
a ratio between two numbers that were never established as comparable is not a speedup

invariants.rule: value == round(value, decimals), value is finite and >= 0, 0 <= decimals <= max_decimals
invariants.why: the consumer prints value verbatim; rounding must not happen at render time
pandas and polars are not interchangeable and the reader must be told which one ran
staleness is checked against the MEASUREMENT date, not the export date

invariants.rule: unit x implies both operands have one identical non-empty measurement_profile
invariants.why: a ratio across different setup, persistence, or reset budgets is not an engine result

invariants.rule: unit 'x' implies operands is an array of exactly two distinct keys of cells
invariants.why: a ratio is a claim ABOUT two other numbers; if it cannot name them, nothing can check that they are still fit to be divided

invariants.rule: for a cell with operands: board_quotable implies every operand is board_quotable, and comparison_allowed implies every operand has comparison_allowed
invariants.why: withdrawing a figure must withdraw everything computed FROM it. Checking each cell's own flags cannot see that its numerator was withdrawn, which is how a withdrawn warm figure stayed quotable as a ratio (pygraphistry #1831)

invariants.rule: for a cell with operands: its disclosures must contain every disclosure of every operand
invariants.why: the asterisk belongs to the number, so it must survive being divided

consumer_obligations: Refuse to render a key the artifact does not contain — a missing number is a build failure, never blank text.
Refuse to render a cell whose run.measured_at is older than policy.max_age_days.
Refuse to render a non-board_quotable cell as a bare number; it may appear only through a role that labels it diagnostic-only.
Render every referenced cell's disclosures and its run's provenance on the same page.
Re-verify every invariant above before rendering, with an implementation that does not import this repository.

cell_optional.operands: array of cell keys this cell was COMPUTED FROM. Required for unit 'x'. Absent means the cell is a direct measurement.
